tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions are as per bid document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder must submit Affidavit on Rs.100 stamp paper stating the firm is not Black listed by any government departments/ agencies/ Institutions
Bidder must submit GST Registration Form 6
Bidder must submit MSME Registration or valid Company/ Partnership/ Proprietorship Registration pertaining to latest amendments
Bidder must submit PAN Registration Certificate

Bidder should enclose Experience/work done/performance certificate of having supplied Stationery items for GOK/GOI/ PSUs/Govt Local Bodies/Govt Boards&Autonomous Institutions in last 3 FY Manufacturer/Authorized dealer should have supplied at least 80/30 percent of the quantities specified amounting to at least Rs.23.37/8.76 lakhs respectively

Bidder should have achieved a minimum of Rs. 29.22 Lakhs -Rs.14.61 lakhs for bidders with MSME reg, turnover in any one of the last 5 FY. Balance sheet or profit and loss and IT returns statements for last 3 FY, for last 2 FY for bidders with MSME reg with valid UDIN Number
